summary: Emerald Holding filed an 8-K disclosing that it entered into a merger agreement with entities owned by Apollo Global Management. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into Emerald, with Emerald surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. The transaction is structured as a going-private acquisition. Apollo issued a press release on June 24, 2026, announcing the merger. Consummation is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals and stockholder approval. No specific price per share or premium was disclosed in this filing. Watch for further filings detailing consideration and vote timing; risk-arb involves closing conditions and potential competing bids.
